name: stabilized_steps
description: Stabilized roll, pitch and yaw stick steps from trimmed level flight: the reference scenario of native PX4 (metrics by analysis/response.py). PX4's rate-controller integrators start at zero, so the first settle_s seconds let the closed loop return to the trim before the steps.

reference.recorded: sitl/README.md: Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64, 2026-11-03, release skysurfer-7fb22f72 (the 2026-11 model)
